PrismJS 1.30.0 (MIT), vendored from the npm prismjs distribution.

Only prism-core.min.js, prism-markup.min.js and prism-json.min.js are included,
with an ES module export and automatic highlighting/worker handlers disabled.
Source: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0

This tokenizer runs in syntax-worker.js, never against a live document.
No remote scripts, autoloader, themes or plugins are included. Keep LICENSE.
